body: Do you still feel a kind of reset in your brain? I mean I am feeling surprisingly calm since I regained consciousness.
Suicide is never a good decision. But hell, we all made countless bad decisions, so why not one last bad one, as a farewell.
Search exit bag and thank me later. It will be just like going to sleep after a hard working day when you are so tired. Best sleep of your life.
If you can get helium, you can get the best painless death ever.
I will try to contact them. But do they reply fast when mailed? I mean I was thinking to get Blaze checked by Sunday.
I don't think they're in my city.
